page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top left, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: mula [?] obstipetur & torpeat Spiritus precum & Devotionis, quàm, ne confusa & immeditata varietas distrahat illum penitus, vel excludat.

Quamquam verò haud repugnem exerceri à Ministris dona sua, etiam in publico, dum id graviter fiat & humiliter, & eâ quâ decet prudentia, quo, & sua forsan magis & Populi studia excitari possint, & in præsens negotium præparari; nulla suadet propterea necessitas, ut quantacunque visingenii, & eximiæ dotes privatorum hominum, pellant penitus ab Ecclesia, vel illi fraude eripiant conjunctas facultates & confspirantia dona tot Doctrinæ & pietatis laude præstantium, quales erant, qui nostram illam Formam Publicam composuerunt, qui sanè merito existimentur ampliori fuisse Gratiâ & Donis instructi, quò maturâ deliberatione, & confociatis consiliis, eas Formas precum componerent, quæ communibus Ecclesiæ indigentiis optimè possent competere, tum Auditorum intellectus informare, & eam denique fiduciam & fervidam mentis intentionem (vitam scilicet Precum & Animam, verumque Illum quem sic crebro jactant Spiritum) fœlicius multo excitare, quàm sperandum sit ab uno homine, quantácunque seorsim

page.notes: The first word "mula" at the top is a fragment and its start is unclear; marked [?]. The printed text has "Miniftris" followed by a small mark that I did not transcribe. The Greek running head is copied as printed; the Greek letters are read from the scan and should be checked.
